Blue-collar buddies (Sidney Poitier, Bill Cosby) search the underworld for a winning lottery ticket lost in a nightclub holdup.
programme.title: Uptown Saturday Night

programme.desc: A circus performer falls for an heir in the 1840s New Orleans during Mardi Gras.
programme.title: Dixiana

programme.desc: A GI (John Forsythe) falls for a U.S. ambassador's daughter (Olivia de Havilland) who fights a senator's plan to make Paris off limits.
programme.title: The Ambassador's Daughter

programme.desc: One U.S. soldier (Paul Douglas) warns another (Montgomery Clift) about the latter's German girlfriend (Cornell Borchers) during the Berlin airlift.
programme.title: The Big Lift

programme.desc: A rancher's (John Wayne) wife (Maureen O'Hara) summons him home to hunt down the outlaw (Richard Boone) and gang who kidnapped his grandson.
programme.title: Big Jake

programme.desc: In a society where life ends at age 30, a law enforcement officer known as a Sandman (Michael York) flees with another 30-year-old (Jenny Agutter) when he learns his number has come up prematurely.
programme.title: Logan's Run

programme.desc: The girl (Glynnis O'Connor) next door makes a teen (John Travolta) born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.
programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble

programme.desc: Billy the Kid (Jack Buetel), Doc Holliday (Walter Huston) and Pat Garrett hang out with a hussy (Jane Russell).
programme.title: The Outlaw

programme.desc: A surgeon (Paul Lukather) transplants a murdered man's hands to a concert pianist (James Stapleton) and the hands begin to drive him mad.
programme.title: Hands of a Stranger

programme.desc: A New York patrolman (Darren McGavin) sees police-academy potential in a klutz (Jerry Lewis) mistaken for a street-gang hoodlum.
programme.title: The Delicate Delinquent

programme.desc: Lt. Col. James Doolittle (Spencer Tracy) leads B-25s off the USS Hornet's deck on a 1942 mission to bomb Japan.
programme.title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo

programme.desc: Cord McNally searches for the two traitors whose treachery causes the loss of a dear friend and the defeat of McNally's unit.
programme.title: Rio Lobo

programme.desc: The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).
programme.title: Hercules and the Captive Women

programme.desc: A U-boat Nazi (Eric Portman) and his comrades raid a Canadian outpost, hijack a seaplane and kill to reach the United States.
programme.title: 49th Parallel

programme.desc: A killer of Detroit clergy confesses to a priest (Donald Sutherland), who turns sleuth because he cannot tell the police.
programme.title: The Rosary Murders

programme.desc: An owner of an escort service hatches some enterprising schemes to turn business around during World War II.
programme.title: Miss London Ltd.

programme.desc: William Wyler's Oscar-winning classic about the tensions faced by a family of hard-working Brits in war-torn England.
programme.title: Mrs. Miniver

programme.desc: A couple (Ron Howard, Cindy Williams) and their high-school friends do their own things on four mid-1960s New Year's Eves.
programme.title: More American Graffiti

programme.desc: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).
programme.title: Sitting Bull

programme.desc: A Quaker (Gail Russell) and her family reform a wounded outlaw (John Wayne) who has a killer on his trail.
programme.title: Angel and the Badman

programme.desc: A Greek sponge diver (Robert Wagner) in Florida loves the daughter (Terry Moore) of a rival family of Key West sponge hookers.
programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef

programme.desc: A British captain (Kenneth More) uses an old train to get a Hindu prince, his governess (Lauren Bacall) and others out of a besieged citadel.
programme.title: Northwest Frontier

programme.desc: A murdered gangster makes a deal with the devil, agreeing to take over and corrupt a crusading judge's identity in return for avenging his murder.
programme.title: Angel on My Shoulder

programme.desc: A corporate climber (Jack Lemmon), whose boss (Fred MacMurray) and others use his apartment for hanky-panky, aids a young woman (Shirley MacLaine).
programme.title: The Apartment

programme.desc: Incompatible friends (Bob Hope, Lucille Ball), taken for granted by their spouses, fall in love after having to spend time alone together.
programme.title: The Facts of Life

programme.desc: A New York dancer (Fred Astaire) grooms a chorus girl (Judy Garland) to be his new partner, falling in love along the way.
programme.title: Easter Parade

programme.desc: A French diplomat (Jean-Pierre Aumont) falls for a recent graduate (Ginger Rogers) of a Paris school for pickpockets.
programme.title: Heartbeat
